## Claim

The RMS error of the pi estimate falls as one over the square root of the sample size.

## Licensed by

- `R-4`: the fitted slope of the RMS error.

## Bounds that travel with it

One estimator and one random generator.

## Must not be said

- That every Monte Carlo estimate converges at this rate.
